requirements.summary: Show a quantitative Intermittent Fasting detail panel on the dashboard when the fasting factor is selected, and hide it when de-selected.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user selects the fasting factor marker, a fasting-focused panel/section becomes visible in the dashboard.

The fasting panel uses a clearly data-forward layout (e.g., KPI tiles, small tables/lists, and timeline-style blocks) and uses legible numeric typography (e.g., monospace for time/metrics) consistent with the existing dark theme.
The fasting panel can be dismissed/hidden by de-selecting the fasting marker (clicking it again), consistent with the current selectedFactor toggle behavior.

file_operations.description: Wire the Intermittent Fasting panel into the existing dashboard render tree so it conditionally appears only when selectedFactor === 'fasting' and disappears when toggled off; keep it in normal document flow (no overlay) to avoid blocking helix visuals/marker interactions.

Create a data-forward Intermittent Fasting panel component (KPIs, structured blocks, compact lists, timeline-style sections) styled for the existing dark theme and readable numeric presentation. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card primitives already used in the app) where appropriate to match existing visuals; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small global utility for metric typography (e.g., tabular numbers) to improve legibility of numeric KPIs/timers while remaining consistent with the existing dark theme and monospace usage.

requirements.summary: Implement the fasting panel’s six content groups (status, live timer, progress, daily/weekly summary, streak, insights/tips) with i18n in EN/DE.
acceptanceCriteria: The fasting panel shows all six content groups (status, timer, progress, daily/weekly summary, streak, insights/tips).
The timer readout updates while visible (at least once per second) and remains performant (no UI jank).
Daily/weekly stats and streak are displayed as numeric values in a consistent unit format.
All new labels/messages in the fasting panel are translated via the existing translations dictionary and switch correctly with the language toggle.

file_operations.description: Implement the panel contents: (1) current status block, (2) timer-style readout, (3) current-window progress indicator, (4) daily+weekly summary KPIs (sessions count/total hours), (5) streak metric, and (6) phase-based insights/tips area; use the existing i18n hook for all user-facing strings and apply monospace/tabular numeric styling for time/metrics. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card primitives) for structured KPI tiles/blocks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a lightweight hook that computes the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed/remaining time, and progress for the current window; update at least once per second only while the panel is mounted/visible (cleanup on unmount) to prevent unnecessary work and UI jank.

Add frontend-only helpers to derive display-ready daily/weekly summaries and streak from a local (non-persisted) model (per non-goals), returning consistent units (hours, sessions) and stable formatting inputs for the panel.
Add shared duration/time formatting utilities for timer and KPI display (e.g., HH:MM:SS, hours with one consistent rounding rule) used by the fasting panel to keep numeric outputs consistent.

Extend the existing Translations type and EN/DE dictionaries with a new fastingPanel namespace containing all labels, unit strings, status phrases (Fasting/Eating/Starts in), summary labels, streak label, and phase-based insights/tips text; ensure no hardcoded user-facing strings remain in the panel.

requirements.summary: Ensure the fasting panel integrates responsively into StartDashboard without overlapping/obscuring helix visuals or breaking factor marker interactions and accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, the fasting panel content remains readable without horizontal overflow and stacks appropriately.
On larger screens, the fasting panel does not overlap the factor marker cards; spacing and z-indexing keep the helix/markers usable.
All existing factor markers remain clickable and keyboard-accessible as before.

file_operations.description: Adjust the dashboard layout to allocate space for the fasting panel below (or adjacent with responsive stacking) the helix markers, ensuring spacing/z-index keep the helix and factor marker cards unobstructed and fully interactive across breakpoints.

Implement responsive layout rules (grid/stacking, compact KPI tiles, no horizontal overflow) and ensure the panel does not introduce absolute-position overlays; verify that all interactive elements within the panel are keyboard reachable without affecting existing marker keyboard behavior. Use shadcn-ui components where helpful for consistent spacing/structure; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
